title: BambooHR integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About BambooHR
BambooHR is an all-in-one HR software designed to manage the complete employee lifecycle, from hiring to onboarding and beyond. Its built-in applicant tracking system helps HR teams streamline job postings, candidate tracking and hiring workflows so organisations can find, evaluate and hire the right talent efficiently.
Why Integrate BambooHR with Xobin?
Integrating BambooHR with Xobin brings skill-based assessments directly into your existing hiring workflow. Assessments are triggered automatically by candidate status changes, eliminating manual follow-ups and reducing hiring delays. Recruiters can track progress, view results in real time and access detailed evaluation reports within BambooHR, ensuring consistent, data-driven hiring decisions and improved quality of hire.
Steps to Integrate BambooHR with Xobin
Add Xobin candidate statuses in BambooHR
Log in to BambooHR and navigate to
Settings
Under the
Hiring
section select
Candidate Statuses
Add these statuses exactly as listed:
Send Xobin Assessment
Xobin Assessment Pending
Xobin Assessment Completed
Initiate the integration from Xobin settings
Log in to Xobin and go to
Settings > Integrations
Locate the BambooHR integration and toggle it
Enter your BambooHR subdomain and click
Create Integration
You are redirected to BambooHR to allow access and grant Xobin the required permissions.
Map BambooHR jobs to Xobin assessments
In Xobin settings select
Link BambooHR Jobs to Assessment
Choose a BambooHR job and map it to the relevant Xobin assessment.
Save the mappings so the correct assessment is triggered for each role.
Send assessment invites from BambooHR
Open the
tab in BambooHR and select a mapped job.
Move a candidate's status to
Xobin sends the invite automatically and the status updates to
Track and review results
Monitor candidate progress directly in their BambooHR profile.
On completion the status updates to
Scores and a link to the detailed Xobin report are available in the
Notes
section of the candidate profile.
Who is this integration for?
This integration is ideal for HR teams, recruiters and talent acquisition leaders using BambooHR who want to enhance hiring with skill-based assessments. It is especially useful for small to mid-sized organisations seeking to automate candidate evaluation, reduce manual coordination and make objective, data-driven hiring decisions across technical and non-technical roles.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Status-triggered assessments
Moving a candidate to Send Xobin Assessment fires the invite and flips the status to Xobin Assessment Pending.
Subdomain-based connection
Toggle BambooHR on in Xobin, enter your subdomain and grant permissions, no manual key copying required.
Job-to-assessment mapping
Link BambooHR Jobs to Assessment pairs each role with the right Xobin test so the correct assessment always goes out.
Scores in candidate notes
Completed results and a link to the full Xobin report appear in the Notes section of the BambooHR profile.
Assessment progress on the hiring board
The Send, Pending and Completed statuses make where every candidate stands visible at a glance in BambooHR.
Fair, like-for-like comparison
Every applicant for a role receives the same mapped test, so shortlists compare candidates on the same evidence.
Answers
Frequently asked questions
Exactly three: Send Xobin Assessment, Xobin Assessment Pending and Xobin Assessment Completed, added under Settings > Hiring > Candidate Statuses.
